name: START_MOTORWAY_GREEN_LONG
notes: TfNSW plan R6-241n (Roads & Maritime 2019 sheet, 1:15, text outlined). Size (B) 1800 x 900 drawn, R150 ((A) 1200 x 600, R100, 140 E also on the sheet; the largest is generated). Corner pair '30 / 30' = green edge 30 + white border 30. Vertical chain 180 / 210 / 120 / 210 / 180, START 210 E, MOTORWAY 210 Series D (labelled '210E' on the sheet, but its stated 1470 is the Series D width — E would be 1742 — as on R6-243n), white; widths 416 / 968 / 417 and 165 / 1470 / 165. Companion of R6-243n END MOTORWAY.
